patients.summary: Healthy electrical contractor who joined the practice in 2023. Exertional dyspnea and chest pain in 2025 led to a murmur, a cardiology referral and a diagnosis of obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy treated with metoprolol; symptoms progressed in 2026 and he awaits an HCM center consult.

documents.title: New Patient Call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller is a 33 y/o man asking about membership. His last doctor retired and the group reassigned him to someone he never met. Mostly wants to be able to reach a person when he needs one. Explained membership fee and that insurance still covers labs and specialists. Signed up over the phone. New-patient physical booked 6/13 at 8:40, fasting. Records release form emailed for his old office.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
33M here to establish. Previous PCP retired; he went a few years without a physical. No complaints today.

PMH: none. Takes nothing, not even OTC regularly.
PSH: tonsils out at 8. Arthroscopic knee surgery at 28, doesn't remember which side offhand; no issues since.
Allergies: NKDA.
FH: dad has high blood pressure, diagnosed around 62. Mom has an underactive thyroid, found around 60. Nobody he knows of with a heart problem in someone young, no one who died suddenly.
SH: runs a small electrical contracting outfit, on job sites most days, up and down ladders. Never smoked. A beer or two on Saturday/Sunday. No other substances.

ROS: negative across the board. Good exercise tolerance at work.

Exam: vitals as recorded. Well appearing. HEENT unremarkable, tonsillar pillars surgically absent. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart RRR, S1 S2 normal. Lungs clear. Abdomen benign. Knees without effusion, full ROM. Skin clear. Mood and affect normal.

A/P: healthy adult male, preventive care.
- Tdap today, last tetanus shot he can recall was in high school.
- Fasting CBC, CMP, lipids, A1c. One-time hep C and HIV screen, he agrees.
- PHQ-2 negative.
- Sunscreen and ear protection on site discussed briefly.
- Physical yearly; text or call for anything in between.

documents.title: Your June Labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Nathan, everything from Tuesday is back and normal: blood counts, kidney and liver numbers, sugar/A1c and cholesterol all where they should be. The hepatitis C and HIV screens were both negative, and those don't need repeating unless something changes. Nothing to do until next year's physical.

documents.title: RE: Your June Labs
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Great, appreciate the quick turnaround. Old office used to take two weeks to tell me anything.

documents.title: Records From Prior Primary Care Office
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Received by fax, 14 pages, from his previous family medicine office. Covers 2014-2021.

Contents: yearly or every-other-year physicals, all unremarkable; one sick visit 2017 for a viral cold; pre-op clearance note 2018 before outpatient knee arthroscopy (orthopedics), uncomplicated; basic labs 2016 and 2019 within normal limits. Med list empty throughout. Allergies: NKDA. No problem list entries.

Scanned to chart and routed to PCP. PCP reviewed: nothing new to add.

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Early slot before his job site. Screening questions negative, no prior vaccine reactions. Flu vaccine 0.5 mL IM left arm. 2023-24 COVID (Pfizer) IM right arm. VIS sheets offered, he declined paper copies. Observed 15 min, no reaction. Out the door 8:15.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
34M, yearly exam. Busy spring, two crews going now. Feels well. Sleeping fine. Still the occasional weekend beer, no tobacco ever.

Meds: none. NKDA.

ROS: no exertional symptoms, no weight change, no GI or GU complaints.

Exam: vitals reviewed. Comfortable, fit. Eyes, ears, throat normal. No lymphadenopathy. Cardiac exam regular, S1 S2 normal. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Extremities warm, good pulses. Skin without concerning lesions.

A/P: well adult.
- Labs from last June were all normal; nothing needed today.
- PHQ-2 0.
- Tdap current (2023). Will get flu and COVID shots in October.
- Back in a year.

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Came after work. Feeling well, no fever. Flu (2024-25 trivalent) 0.5 mL IM L arm and 2024-25 Moderna IM R arm. Lots and expirations in the immunization record. Tolerated both; sat 15 minutes, fine.
